title: Safe Medication Administration Protocol
description: Standard procedure for safe administration of medications following the 5 Rights
references: Institute for Safe Medication Practices Guidelines

steps.details: Use two patient identifiers: full name and date of birth. Check patient wristband and ask patient to state their name.
warnings: Do not rely on room number alone

steps.details: Compare medication label with order. Check medication name, ensuring it matches both generic and brand names if applicable.
Confirm dose matches order. If calculation required, have second nurse verify. Check unit of measurement.
Confirm route of administration matches order (PO, IV, IM, etc.). Ensure route is appropriate for medication and patient condition.
validation_criteria: Patient able to receive via this route
warnings: Some medications cannot be given via certain routes
IV medications require patent IV access

steps.details: Administer medication within 30 minutes of scheduled time. Check for time-critical medications that require exact timing.
warnings: Document if given outside time window

steps.details: Review patient allergy list in EHR. Ask patient about previous reactions. Check for drug interactions.
warnings: Do not administer if any concerns about allergy
Consult pharmacist if unsure about interaction

steps.details: Explain medication purpose, expected effects, and potential side effects. Answer patient questions.
Use appropriate technique for route. Stay with patient during administration. Monitor for immediate reactions.
warnings: Never leave medication at bedside unsupervised
Watch for signs of adverse reaction

steps.details: Document in EHR immediately after administration. Include time, dose, route, and site if applicable. Note any patient response or concerns.
warnings: Do not document before giving medication

steps.details: Monitor patient for therapeutic effect and adverse reactions. Follow up according to medication guidelines.
